title: Freya and the Spire
author: Rafael Whitlock
blurb: Theo Whitlock, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
